title: Config-Driven PySpark ETL Framework
problem: New ETL jobs were built one-off per source, duplicating logic and slowing delivery.
approach: Designed a reusable framework where a pipeline is defined by configuration — source, schema, transformation rules, target — with built-in validation, reconciliation, and Bash-driven job execution.
outcome: Became the standard pattern for new batch pipelines on the team — turning a one-off build into a configuration change saved development time and effort, while shared, reusable logic reduced duplicated code across pipelines, cutting down on redundant processing and the compute resources and memory it consumed.

title: Legacy Warehouse Migration & ETL Modernization
problem: 15+ legacy reporting workflows on an older warehouse/BI platform needed to move onto a modern Hadoop-based stack without breaking downstream reporting.
approach: Translated legacy SQL and ETL logic into HiveQL- and Informatica BDM-based pipelines, making queries compatible with Impala SQL as well for faster ad hoc access downstream, with validation and reconciliation built into every migration before cutover.
outcome: 15+ datasets modernized with preserved data consistency and reporting continuity — consolidating reporting onto a single modern Hadoop-based platform, reducing the organization's dependence on the ageing Netezza/Cognos stack, and simplifying ongoing support and maintenance for the team going forward.

title: Large-Scale ETL & Reporting Pipeline Delivery
problem: Business reporting depended on 30+ ETL workflows running on daily, monthly, quarterly, and custom-date SLAs.
approach: Built and optimized workflows with configurable runtime parameters and partition-based loading, tuning HiveQL and Impala SQL for scale throughout. Informatica BDM-based pipelines were the original approach; newer workflows were later built in PySpark using the DataFrame API and Spark SQL for enterprise batch processing.
outcome: Reliable, SLA-compliant delivery across a large, varied pipeline portfolio.

title: Transformation Logic Enhancements & RCA
problem: Regulatory and enterprise reporting pipelines — including IFRS 9 reporting — needed continual business-rule changes and fast, accurate root-cause resolution; deadlines don't move for regulatory reporting, and errors have to be caught before they reach the report.
approach: Implemented business rule enhancements, derived columns, and workflow redesigns to keep pipelines aligned with changing reporting requirements and SLA commitments. Performed RCA and pipeline-level debugging across multi-stage ETL workflows to resolve data mismatches, transformation issues, and production defects.
outcome: 15+ complex enhancement and data-issue requests resolved across multiple reporting domains, including IFRS 9 reporting pipelines — pipelines kept accurate and within SLA through changing business requirements, with issues traced to root cause and fixed at the source rather than patched downstream.
